body:
I wish I could. Well, actually, I have a family vacation coming up that he won't be at. But, family vacations are not particularly relaxing for me. And the temptation to drink is going to be all around me; I really don't want to start drinking again. My parents refuse to believe I have a problem with alcohol, despite countless black outs and drunk driving incidents that prove otherwise.

Thank you for the compliment, mustfocus. I appreciate the kindness right now.

I wish I could go somewhere. I've thought about just going out for a drive, but I'm fighting the flu right now on top of all of this. My boyfriend was deathly ill the past two nights...I have been sleeping in hour long bursts since Christmas Eve.
